turns.mechanic: 2025 Integra 1.5 turbo. I need the wiring from the VSA unit to the left front wheel speed sensor.
turns.note: The diagram draws this circuit twice: (1) except 1.5L Turbo CVT Integra, (2) 1.5L Turbo CVT Integra. The reply must give both, marked, or ask which car it is.

must_do: Give the part common to both versions: VSA modulator-control unit pin 33 (BRN) and pin 32 (BLU)
Say the diagram has two versions of this circuit and ask which car it is, or give both versions clearly marked
For the 1.5L Turbo CVT Integra: BRN to sensor pin 1 and BLU to sensor pin 2
For the other version: through connector C304 (pin 2 on the BRN wire, pin 1 on the BLU wire), and say the diagram gives no colour for the sensor-side wires
must_not: State a pin, colour or connector that is not on the diagram
Report NCA as a wire colour
Send the diagram image when the mechanic did not ask for it
Give one version's wiring as if it applied to every car

source.file: Anti-Lock Brakes (Antilock Brakes _ Traction Control Systems).pdf

open_questions: The mechanic's messages were written by us. The client's mechanic should check they sound natural.
The expected pins, colours and connectors were read by eye from the diagram page. Compare with the extracted record in Milestone 2.
Confirm that NCA on these diagrams means the wire colour is not available.
